chunks: Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from 'Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام.
That he asked him about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“And We have certainly written in the Zabur after the Dhikr.”

What is the Zabur, and what is the Dhikr? He عليه السلام said: “The Dhikr is with Allah, and the Zabur is that which was sent down upon Dawud. And every Book that was sent down, it is with the People of Knowledge, and we are they.”

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ: The People of Knowledge who possess the revealed books.
key_terms.الذِّكْرِ: The Reminder that is with Allah in this context.
key_terms.الزَّبُورِ: The scripture revealed to Dawud عليه السلام, the Psalms.
key_terms.دَاوُدَ: The Prophet Dawud عليه السلام, to whom the Zabur was revealed.
key_terms.كِتَابٍ: Any revealed scripture sent down by Allah.

ai.seo_question: Who are the Ahl al-'Ilm mentioned in the hadith on the Zabur and the Dhikr?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about the Zabur and the Dhikr by identifying the Zabur as the scripture sent down to Dawud عليه السلام and stating that the Dhikr is with Allah. It further declares that every revealed Book is with the Ahl al-'Ilm, whom the Imam عليه السلام identifies as the Imams عليهم السلام.
